TestBatch::test_batch_prepared_with_slow.description: Single node. Enables slow query logging via REST POST /storage_service/slow_query (threshold=0), runs the batch_ttl_conditional_interaction scenario (driver BatchStatements containing a prepared conditional UPDATE), disables slow log, asserts the log has no 'No "query" parameter set for a session requesting a slow_query_log record' line and that system_traces.node_slow_log contains a row with command == the conditional UPDATE text. Guards scylladb/scylladb#5843 (slow-log of batches of prepared statements logged an ERROR and dropped the record), fixed by scylla 0afa738a8f.

TestBatch::test_batch_prepared_with_slow.reason: Only test touching slow-log of batches (#5843, no regression test in scylla commit 0afa738a8f), but assertions are weak. Bug: grep_log targets a message that is TRACE-level since the fix (tracing/trace_keyspace_helper.cc:317), so it only fires if the fix is reverted to ERROR level. Bug: counter[update_command]>0 is satisfied by the PREPARE trace session (transport/server.cc:1707 add_query on PREPARE), not by the batch, so batch slow-logging isn't actually verified. Note: reruns the whole ~18s-sleep TTL scenario just to produce batches; slow log disable not in finally.

TestBatch::test_batch_ttl_conditional_in.description: Single node port of Cassandra BatchTest.testBatchTTLConditionalInteraction: sequence of driver BatchStatements mixing (prepared) inserts/deletes/range deletes with conditional UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE (LWT) and TTL'd statements on a clustered table; asserts table contents after each batch, that a failed condition skips the entire batch, and TTL expiry after 6s sleeps.

TestBatch::test_batch_static_ttl_conditi.description: Single node port of Cassandra BatchTest.testBatchStaticTTLConditionalInteraction: batches on a table with a static column, mixing conditional updates on static (IF sval=...), static updates, deletes, range deletes, IF NOT EXISTS and TTL statements; asserts rows after each batch, that a non-matching static condition skips the batch, and TTL expiry after sleeps.
